heading: Sunday Night
text: A few clouds and showers north ending just after dark. Becoming mostly clear. Areas of dense valley fog. Cold, lows in the 40s to low 50s. Winds northwest near 10 mph, diminishing to light outside the Champlain Valley.

heading: Monday, Labor Day
text: Dense valley fog burning off by mid-morning. Mostly sunny. Highs in the low to mid 70s. Light winds, becoming northwest near 10 mph.

heading: Monday Night
text: Mostly clear, then some periods of clouds. Scattered shower near and north of the Quebec border late. Lows in the upper 40s to mid 50s.
